Please call 000 straight away if you feel very drowsy or confused, or if you cannot swallow safely. Please ask someone to stay with you until your level is back up.

Important information and the app version.
These settings change how the app looks and sounds. They do not change your plan or your records.
Shows white and yellow text on a black background.
The home screen shows only the next step and the main buttons.
Shows a short explanation under buttons and settings, like this one.
Turns off moving effects where possible.
Reads your dose and other results aloud when they appear.
Vibrate when I press a button
A short vibration confirms each press.

This app works out insulin doses from the sliding scale that you entered from your doctor’s order. It does not give medical advice. Please speak with your doctor or diabetes educator if you have questions about your insulin.
Your records are stored only on this phone. They are included in your phone’s own backup if you have turned that on. You can share them with your doctor from Settings › Export for your doctor.
The advice shown for low and high readings is general information. Please ask your doctor or diabetes educator what you should do, and follow their advice if it is different.

Your plan holds the details of your prescription and your goals. You can change it when your doctor changes your prescription.
Change your sliding scale, times, medicines or goals.
Start a new cycle with new goals. Your earlier plans are kept.
Each time your plan changes, a new version is saved. Your records keep the version that was in place when they were made.
This version started a new plan.
Your plan holds your prescription. Please change it only when your doctor has changed your prescription, or to correct a mistake. Would you like to continue?
Your plan is protected by a personal identification number (PIN). Please enter your PIN to change your plan.
That PIN is incorrect. Please try again.
Your PIN will be removed, and your plan will no longer be protected. Your plan and records will not change. You can set a new PIN afterwards in Settings › Your plan.
Your PIN must have exactly 4 digits.
The two PINs are different. Please enter the same PIN twice.
Your readings from now on will use the changed plan. Your earlier records will keep the plan that was in place when they were made.
You have not changed anything in your plan.

This app helps you record your weight and your blood glucose level (BGL). It works out your insulin dose from the sliding scale that your doctor has prescribed, and it guides you through each check, one step at a time.
Please choose a text size that is comfortable to read. You can change it later in Settings.
Please have your doctor’s sliding scale order in front of you. The next few steps copy the details from that order.
Name of the insulin on your sliding scale

Please enter each row of the sliding scale as it appears on your order. The first row starts at 0, and each row starts just above the row before it. The last row covers every reading above the row before it.
This fills in 0 to 10 with 0 units, 10.1 to 12 with 2 units, and so on up to 10 units above 20. Please change any row that is different on your order.
Please compare this table with your doctor’s order, row by row. Your doses will come from this table.
I have checked this against my doctor’s order.
Please choose when you check your blood glucose level (BGL) and when your order lists your sliding-scale insulin. On the order, these are the boxes under Times to administer insulin.
Check my BGL at this time
My order lists %1$s at this time
The app also shows the sliding-scale dose at other check times, and asks you to confirm before you record one.
Please add each medicine that you take at set times, such as a premixed insulin or tablets. The app will ask about them at each check. You can leave this list empty.
You have not added any medicines yet.
For example, 25 mg. You can leave this empty.
What kind of medicine is it?
Please enter the amount for each time you take it. Leave a time empty if you do not take it then.
Your goals help you see your progress. You can leave any goal empty and add it later.
How often would you like to weigh yourself?
How often would you like to measure your waist?
These numbers are filled in with common values. Please confirm your target range and your low level with your doctor.
Lowest reading in your target range
Highest reading in your target range
A reading below your low level counts as low. The app will not show a %1$s dose for a low reading, and will show what to do instead.
A personal identification number (PIN) stops your plan from being changed by accident. You will need it to change your sliding scale, times or medicines. Would you like to set one now?
The app can remind you when it is time to check your blood glucose level (BGL) and take your medicines. To do this, it needs your permission to show notifications.
To remind you at the right time, the app also needs permission to set alarms. Your phone will open its settings page, where you can turn this on.
You can change these permissions later in your phone’s settings.
Please check each part of your plan. You can change any part before you start.
Please choose the part of your plan that you would like to change. Your changes are saved when you press Save changes.
You do not check your BGL
Please enter the name of the insulin on your sliding scale.
Please enter the highest reading for row %1$d, for example 12.
Please enter the units of insulin for row %1$d.
The highest reading in row %1$d must be more than the highest reading in the row above.
The highest reading in row %1$d must be between 0.1 and 33.3 mmol/L.
The units for row %1$d must be between 0 and 50.
Please check the table against your doctor’s order, then tick the box.
Please choose at least one time to check your BGL.
Please enter the name of the medicine.
Please enter an amount for at least one time of day.
Please enter how the medicine is measured, for example puffs.
Please check the amount %1$s. It should be a number, such as 1 or 0.5.
Please enter a starting weight between 30 and 300 kg, or leave it empty.
Please enter a goal weight between 30 and 300 kg, or leave it empty.
Please enter a starting waist measurement between 40 and 250 cm, or leave it empty.
Please enter a goal waist measurement between 40 and 250 cm, or leave it empty.
The target date must be after the start date.
Please enter the lowest reading in your target range, for example 4.0.
Please enter the highest reading in your target range, for example 10.0.
Please enter your low level, for example 4.0.
The lowest reading in your target range must be less than the highest.
These are your records, with the newest day first. Please choose a day to see or change its records.
You have no records yet. Your readings and doses will appear here after your first check.
You can change a record if it was entered by mistake, or delete it. Each change is saved straight away.
There are no records for this day.
The record will be removed from your logbook. You can undo this straight afterwards.
Please enter a reading from 1.1 to 33.3 mmol/L.
Please enter an amount, such as 4 or 0.5.
Please enter a weight from 30 to 300 kg, a waist measurement from 40 to 250 cm, or both.
This page shows how your weight and blood glucose level (BGL) have changed over time.
A chart of %1$d weights, from %2$s kg to %3$s kg.
A chart of %1$d blood glucose readings, from %2$s to %3$s mmol/L. The shaded band is your target range, and the dashed line is your low level.
The shaded band shows your target range. The dashed line shows your low level. Blue dots are in your target range, orange dots are above or below it, and red dots are low.
You have no readings in this period.
These are the medicines in your plan for today. You can record any that you have not recorded yet.
Your plan has no medicines at set times. You can add them in Settings › Your plan.
For example, I did not have lunch today
Reminders to check your blood glucose level and take your medicines.
Time to check your blood glucose level
It is time to check your blood glucose level (BGL) %1$s. Please tap here to start.
It is time to take your medicines %1$s. Please tap here to record them.
Please check your blood glucose level again
It has been 15 minutes since your low reading. Please check your blood glucose level again now.
The app reminds you at each check time in your plan. It does not remind you about a check that you have already recorded.
Turn this off to stop all reminders from this app.
The app cannot show reminders until you allow notifications. Would you like to allow them now?
Reminders may be a few minutes late
Your phone may delay reminders by up to ten minutes. If you allow the app to set alarms, reminders will arrive on time.
To change these times, please change your plan in Settings › Your plan.
Shows a reminder now, so you can see what it looks like.
You can create a report or a spreadsheet of your records to share with your doctor or diabetes educator. Your phone will then ask how you would like to send it, for example by email.
A printable report with your plan, a summary, a chart and your daily records.
Opens in Excel, with the same columns as a paper or spreadsheet log.

Something went wrong while creating the file. Please try again.
